items.title: Bernstein upgrades Maire on de-risked projects, LNG technology growth potential
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein upgraded oil services group Maire to "outperform" from "market-perform" and raised its price target to €16.90 from €13.30, citing progress on the company’s Middle East projects, which has reduced risk across its overall project portfolio.

items.title: Basin rig count up two as prices decline
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up two this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 275 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 253 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is down three from last week at 601 rigs. A year ago, 549 rigs were active.
